# Whollar winter tires

> Whollar brings drivers in one area together so tire installers and
> distributors bid for the whole cohort at once, instead of quoting one car at
> a time. This host is the winter tire product. Greater Toronto Area,
> Winter 2026.

Whollar is one organisation across several hosts. The umbrella is
https://www.whollar.ca/ and the internet product is https://internet.whollar.ca/.

## Pages

- [Winter tires](https://tires.whollar.ca/): what the tire cohort is, how a
  cohort forms, what a household gets, and which cities are open.

## What this is not

- Not a retailer. Whollar never sells tires and never sits between a household
  and its installer.
- Not a quote. Joining is a vote for a cohort, nothing is charged, and a
  household picks and pays its own installer.
